Commentary.Commentary: Right. Back for the run chase. Aaron Finch and Matthew Wade are the openers for the visitors. Fidel Edwards to begin with the ball. Here we go...

Right then. 146 needed for the Aussies, to begin the tour with a victory. With their batting line-up, you would expect them to chase it down, but the hosts have shown that they could bowl well and make life difficult for the visitors. Stay tuned for what could be a spicy run chase.

Shimron Hetmyer is in for a chat! He says it is just how they formalize and how quickly they settle in. Adds that it is a little up and down journey for them but this will only help them come out stronger. Adds that with Pooran, the role was only to put the balls away, and with Russell, he says it was easy for him as he just had to rotate the strike and Russell did what he does best.

What can we say about the Australians? On their best day, they just looked untouchable. Throughout the game, they were brilliant in the field. No doubt about that, except a few moments. Then comes the bowlers, Marsh picked up a couple of wickets. Agar had a good start with the ball, but later was unable to get the better of Russell as he smashed him all around the park. Hazlewood was the pick of the bowlers, as he snared three wickets and only for 12 runs. The rest of the bowler probed good lines and lengths but were not able to get in the wicket column.

West Indies got off to a really slow start according to their standards. They lost an early wicket in the form of Lewis in the second over. Then, it was the Universe Boss who was sent back into the shed in no time, as he scored a single boundary before his departure. Simmons and Hetmyer looked settled in the middle, but the former was rattled by Marsh. West Indies were struggling to build a partnership. It was Hetmyer and Pooran's partnership that was going good for the hosts, but a mix-up in the middle, cost them their skipper. It was Russell then who took the charge, scored a fifty, and well did enough to make his side reach a defendable total. Allen and Bravo added a couple of runs on the scoreboard as they ended on 145.

SIX! Dwayne Bravo finishes the over with a bang! A back of a length ball, around off and middle, Dwayne Bravo makes room and hooks this one all the way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. WEST INDIES FINISH ON 145/6!
Full ball around off, drilled to long off for one.
On the pads, tickled to the leg side for a quick single.
A fuller ball, on middle and leg, Bravo makes room and swings but does not connect with anything.
Who will come out next? It is Dwayne Bravo!

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Hazlewood gets another wicket and he removes the dangerous Russell. This could prove handy as Russell could have smashed another 15-20 runs in the last couple of balls. A fuller ball, around off, Andre Russell looks to squirt this one out, but the ball takes the inside edge and goes onto clip the stumps behind. A good knock from Russell, just what the Men in Maroon needed!
A yorker on middle, dug out to the man at long off for one.
Josh Hazlewood, after a brilliant Powerplay spell, comes into the attack to bowl the final over.
Leg bye. On the pads, Allen misses his tuck and the ball takes the pad and goes to the off side for a leg bye.
Low full toss on off, clobbered to long off for one.

SIX! FIFTY FOR RUSSELL! Just what the hosts needed and the big man delivers. Gets it in just 26 balls and now will be looking to end the innings on a high. Around off, on a length, smoked away over the deep mid-wicket fence. His maiden T20I century too!
A short ball, around middle, AR looks to hook it away but misses.

Almost a great catch! A length ball, around off, Andre Russell flicks this one hard towards the deep mid-wicket region. It does not looks like there is enough gas on this to go all the way. Dan Christian runs to his right, from long on, and Ashton Agar runs to his left, from deep mid-wicket. Dan Christian gets to the ball, falls down and tries to relay it to Agar, but it is behind him and the ball is on the ground. A couple.
Fuller ball, around off, worked through mid on for a single.
Just 8 off the over! A short ball, on middle, Russell looks to pull but misses.
WIDE. Slower length ball, down leg, Russell leaves. Wided.

FOUR! The long off and long on fielders have a miscommunication and that results in a boundary. On a fuller length, around off, Russell drills this one down the ground, in between both the fielders there. They both come together, but none commits to the dive, which allows the ball to go past the ropes.
Slants in a length ball across the right-hander, Andre looks to heave this one to the leg side but fails to connect bat with ball.
On a shortish length, around off, pulled to deep square leg, for one.
Short of a length, on off, guided to short third man for one.
A slower ball, around off, tapped to point for one.
Dan Christian comes back into the attack now.
16 off the over then! A full toss outside off, AR swings but misses.
A yorker around off, jammed out to third man for one.
Edgy couple! Around off, Allen looks to push but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the left of third man, who dives and does well to stop.
Fuller, on off, pushed to long off for one.
SIX! Russell power at its best! Back-to-back biggies and he is having some fun out there. A length ball, outside off, muscled over the long off region for another biggie.
SIX! Starc misses his length, but Russell does not miss out. A full toss outside off, this is drilled over the long on fence for a biggie.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mitchell Marsh gets his second wicket. The West Indies side are falling apart. Mitchell Marsh gets his man and the plan works. He goes wide consecutively for two deliveries, setting up the batsman for the one that comes close to him. He serves it on a length and around off. Hetmyer looks to push it out. The ball though takes the outside edge and flies towards the man at short third man. Where, Mitchell Starc takes a sharp diving catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Starc b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: Out comes Fabian Allen! Also, Mitchell Starc comes back on to bowl. 2-0-14-0 so far.
WIDE! Again full and outside off, Hetmyer goes behind it but misses.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off. Hetmyer leans in as he looks to attack it. But cannot reach it.
Play and a miss! Good length delivery, outside off. Hetmyer looks to go after it but misses.
A length ball, on middle. Russell tucks it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Boundaries coming in all forms for Russell. A touch short, on middle. Andre Russell stays back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Hetmyer pushes it through covers for a single.
LEG BYE! A full length ball, on leg. Russell looks to flick it but misses. The ball ends up on the leg side off the pads. The batters take a leg bye.
A single to end the over. Loopy ball, on the pads. Russell flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Good batting.
AND AGAIN, SIX! Back-to-back sixes. Amazing stuff from Andre Russell. He is pumped up. Tossed up, on off. Russell gets under it and works it over the long on fence this time for a biggie.
SIX! DISPATCHED! This is what Andre Russell does best. Looped up, on off. Russell gets low and powers it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
On off, Hetmyer works it on the leg side and rotates the strike.
LEG BYE! Loopy ball, on the pads. Russell looks to sweep it but misses and gets rapped on the pads. This gets a loud appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. They take a bye.
Loopy ball, on off. Hetmyer hangs back and punches it to long off for a single.
A length ball, on off. Shimron Hetmyer pushes it to cover for a single.

DROPPED! A touch short, on off. Russell goes back and pulls it hard towards mid-wicket. The goes uppishly towards Moises Henriques, who for once looked as if he had the ball in his hands, but the pace on it saved the batsman. The batters pick up a single.
Ashton Agar comes back. 2-0-13-0 so far.
On a length, around off. Russell makes room for himself and pushes it to cover with power. Good stop.
A good length ball, on middle. Russell keeps it out.
Back of a length ball, on middle. Russell ducks under it.
Full length ball, outside off. Hetmyer pushes it to long off for a single.
Andre Russell has just watchfully blocked this out. 7 off the over!
FOUR! POWER! Russell does not take long to get his first boundary. Tossed up, around off, Andre Russell drills this one over the bowler's head and the ball finds the ropes.
On middle, swept away to the man at deep square leg, for one.
Strokes this through covers for one.
Presses forward to this full ball and smothers it out.
On the pads, tossed up, SH works it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Length ball, on off. Hetmyer pushes it to cover for a single.
The big man, Andre Russell makes his way out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh dear, the miscommunication amongst the batsmen cost West Indies another wicket. It is the skipper they lose this time. A full length ball, on the pads. Hetmyer looks to flick it but misses. The ball clips the pads and rolls to the leg side. There is a huge appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. But wait, Pooran wanted a single but was sent back by Shimron Hetmyer. The fielder Josh Philippe collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end, diving forward, and hits the bullseye as well. The Australian side decides to take it upstairs for the run out. The replays roll in and confirm Pooran was outside the crease when the ball hit the stumps. The decision is OUT. But as the skipper reaches the dugout, he is stopped by an umpire on the sidelines. Because the third umpire will review the LBW first on Shimron Hetmyer as Australia took the appeal. So, the Ultra Edge shows no bat. The Ball Tracker shows the impact is outside. So, Hetmyer is safe, but Pooran has to head back.
FOUR! Nicely played. A length ball, on the pads. Hetmyer flicks it through square leg and finds the gap for a boundary.
LEG BYE! A length ball, coming in from off. Pooran looks to works this on the leg side but misses. The ball clips the thigh and rolls to the leg side. The batter sneak a single. Leg Bye given.

Run out? That's a great dive from Josh Philippe to get rid of Pooran. OUT - reads the big screen. Looks like Australia have also taken a review for LBW and they will also check if Shimron Hetmyer could be LBW. No bat, but impact was outside. So, in a nutshell, Shimron Hetmyer is not out and Nicholas Pooran is run out!
Play and a miss! A full length ball, on the fourth stump line. Pooran looks to slog sweep but misses. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Full length ball, on off. Hetmyer drives it to mid off and gets a single.
Mitchell Starc returns. Gave 8 off his only over.
Full and on middle. Hetmyer flicks it through mid-wicket for another single.
Flatter and outside off. Pooran hangs back and punches it to long off for a single.
Floated, on the pads. Pooran tucks it out.
FOUR! Full and down the leg. Nicholas Pooran sweeps it towards fine leg and gets a boundary.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Pooran looks to defend but misses.
Looped up, full and on off, turning away. Nicholas Pooran looks to go after it but misses. Matthew Wade collects the ball to his left and flicks the bails, but the foot never left the crease.
Adam Zampa is called back into the action. He replaces Dan Christian. 1-0-10-0 so far.
Pushed through covers for one.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Nicholas. Just whistled past the man there. A length ball, outside off, Pooran slaps this one aerially past point, who dives that way, but it evades him to go to the ropes.

FOUR! Beats the man in the deep. A back of a length ball, around off, Nicholas Pooran pulls this one to the left of deep mid-wicket and Ashton Agar there, shuffles to his left, but the ball lands short and goes past him, to the ropes.
Fuller ball, around off, drilled to sweeper covers for one.
Full ball, on the hips, clipped to fine leg for one.
Around off, length ball, NP pushes it back to the bowler.
A single as this is turned through square leg.
Hetmyer misses his flick and the ball takes the pad and goes to the leg side for one more leg bye.
Leg bye. On the pads on a length, Pooran misses his tuck but the ball glances his pad and goes to fine leg. They wanted two again but Wade chases the ball down and keeps it down to one leg bye.
Back of a length, on off, Pooran goes back and finds the cover fielder with his punch.
A slower length ball, on the pads, dropped to the leg side for one. The call was for two, but they had to settle for just one.
A touch fuller, around off, flicked to short mid-wicket.
The veteran, Dan Christian comes into the attack now, replacing Adam Zampa.
Another good over for Australia, just 4 runs and a wicket off it! On the pads, flicked to fine leg for one.
A touch fuller on off, worked back to the bowler.
WIDE. A short ball, down the leg side, SH looks to pull, but misses. Wided.
On off on a length, pushed through covers for one.
The skipper Nicholas Pooran walks out in the middle at number 5. Can he play a captain's knock tonight? It looks like his team really needs it.

OUT! EDGED AND CAUGHT! Marsh strikes in his first over and Simmons goes back now. Simmons tried to guide this one to third man but only managed to get it into the glove of Wade, behind him. Slightly behind the good length, around off, Lendl Simmons arches back and looks to steer this to third man, but the only thing he manages is an outside edge. Matthew Wade takes care of the rest. Three down are the hosts now!
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: Flicked nicely to the man at fine leg for a single.
On a fuller length, on middle, this is nudged to the leg side.
Mitchell Marsh comes into the attack now. He replaces Josh Hazlewood.
SIX! Powerful! Floated, around off, Lendl Simmons slogs this one all the way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. 10 off the over!
Outside off, cut to point.

An appeal for LBW but turned down. Around leg, Shimron Hetmyer looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal but the umpire says no. They have a chat as to whether this pitched outside leg and decide that it might have, thus, not opting for the review. No leg bye indicated, so there might have been some bat too.
Around off, pushed through mid off for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Driven through covers for one.
Tossed up on middle and leg, nudged through square leg for one.
Adam Zampa comes into the attack to work his leg spin now. He replaces Ashton Agar.
Around middle, pushed to mid off. West Indies finish their Powerplay, at 24/2!

OUT! CAUGHT! Hazlewood strikes again and the Universe Boss has been sent packing here. He could not get into position quick enough to play the pull shot and the hosts lose their second wicket. Sticks with the short length, around off. Chris Gayle looks to pull but gets hurried, as the ball takes the lower part of the blade and lobs up towards the short third man region. Ashton Agar makes absolutely no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Who will come out at number 4? It is going to be Shimron Hetmyer.
WIDE. On a length, down leg, Gayle looks to tuck it but misses.
This time, connects with the pull, to deep square leg, for one.
Three dots in a row! Around middle and leg, sticks with the short length, Simmons misses his pull and gets hit on the body.

Another short ball, around middle and leg, angling in, Simmons looks to cut but the ball takes the under edge and looks to be trickling to the wickets, but Simmons ensures that there are no blemishes.
A short ball, on middle, Lendl Simmons moves leg side and looks to upper cut this one but misses.
On off, Gayle watchfully keeps it out.
FOUR! Gayle gets off the mark with a boundary. Just like he always does. Agar serves it short and wide outside off. Gayle cuts it over the infield on the off side. The ball ends up in the boundary.
Full and on middle. Gayle nudges it to mid-wicket.
On middle, Simmons tucks it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Simmons looks to go big again but does not get the connection. The ball rolls towards mid on.
SIX! BANG! Lendl Simmons is not waiting anymore. Floated on off, Simmons hangs back and powers it over the long on fence for a biggie.
BEATEN! What a beauty by Josh Hazlewood. Serves it on a length, on off, nipping away. Gayle looks to defend it but misses. The ball beats the outside edge. Maiden!
On a length, outside off. Gayle moves across and looks to defend it but misses.
Good length ball, outside off. Gayle lets it go to the keeper.
Some variable bounce on offer here. A length ball, on off, the ball stays low. Gayle defends it in time.
A length ball, on off. Gayle pushes it to point. He was looking for a single but was sent back.
A touch short, outside off. Gayle taps it out.

Floated on middle, the ball turns in. Simmons yet again is not able to keep it out. He misses his defense and gets hit on the pads. A loud appeal by Matthew Wade from behind the wickets but the umpire is unmoved.
Loopy ball, on leg. Simmons looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, on off. Simmons plays it uppishly towards cover, but with soft hands. The ball falls short of the man there.
Loopy ball, outside off. Simmons guides it to third man and picks up a couple.
Flatter and on off, Simmons stays back and punches it to point.
Floated on the pads. Simmons looks to flick it but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
A length ball, on the pads. Simmons tucks it to square leg for a single. A tidy for for Josh Hazlewood. Just a run and a wicket.
Spin time! Ashton Agar to have a go, early on.
On a length, outside off. Lendl Simmons looks to go after it but misses.
A length ball, on off, Simmons keeps it out.
On off, pushed to cover.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lewis has to make the slow walk back to the dugout without troubling the score. A touch short on off, which enticed Evin Lewis to pull this away, but he does not middle it. The ball flies between mid-wicket and mid on. Mitchell Marsh runs to his left to take a sharp catch. Josh Hazlewood strikes in no time. West Indies lose an early wicket here.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Marsh b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Who will come out now? Cheers and claps as the Universe Boss, Chris Gayle makes his way out into the middle.
Back of a length ball, outside off. The ball gets an extra bounce off the pitch. Lewis looks to chase it but misses.
A length ball, on off, Simmons is solid in his defense.
FOUR! Two-in-two! A length ball, on off. Simmons hangs back and pushes it through the cover region for a boundary. This was an amazing shot.
Who will bowl from the other end? Josh Hazlewood, it is.

FOUR! This gets both Lendl Simmons and West Indies off the mark with a boundary. A full length ball, on off. Simmons looks to work it on the leg side. But the outside edge takes it to third man as the ball finds the boundary.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Simmons looks to chase it but misses.
Simmons already showing aggression. A length ball, on off. Simmons flicks it hard towards mid-wicket.
Starts with a full length ball, on off. Simmons works it to mid on.

The Australian players have made their way out in the middle. The West Indies batters walk out on the pitch. The pair of Lendl Simmons and Evin Lewis to begin for them. Mitchell Starc to start with the ball. But before getting underway, the players of both the teams on their knees, to show their support for the 'Black Lives Matter' movement. Here we go...

Both the teams are lined up as the the Prime Minister of St Lucia, Allen Chastanet, greets everyone. No handshakes due to the pandemic, just elbow bumps. Time for the National Anthems. First, the anthem of West Indies, followed by that of Australia.

PITCH REPORT - Sir Curtly Ambrose is down for the pitch report.  He explains the pitch to us. He says that there are a lot of cracks on the pitch and also a slight green patch. Mentions that the pitch will stay the same for the entire match.

Nicholas Pooran, the West Indies skipper, says that Pollard is not there as he has a niggle and Fabian Allen comes back. Says that they know what they have to work on and they will find a way to win. Tells that practice was really good and they will look to do the right things.

The Australian skipper, Aaron Finch says it looks like a pretty good wicket. Adds that they played two intrasquad games and the breeze helps. Also says he had a slow start in the last series, hopes they get a positive start in the series. Ends by saying he expects a lot from the young lads who came into the side.
West Indies (PLAYING XI) -  Lendl Simmons, Evin Lewis, Chris Gayle, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (C/WK), Andre Russell, Dwayne Bravo, Fabian Allen, Hayden Walsh, Obed McCoy, Fidel Edwards.
Australia (PLAYING XI) -  Aaron Finch (C), Matthew Wade (WK), Mitchell Marsh, Josh Philippe, Moises Henriques, Ben McDermott, Dan Christian, Ashton Agar, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - The umpire and the two skippers are in the middle. Nicholas Pooran flips the coin in the air and it lands in the favour of Australia. They opt to field first.

Woohoo! Cricket continues its carnival in the Caribbean. After the Proteas touched their shores, now, Australia make their way to battle the Men in Maroon, for 5 T20Is and 3 ODIs, starting with the former. The hosts were beaten comprehensively in their last assignment against South Africa and will be looking to make amends. The team from Down Under will want to test their bench and win this series, as they warm themselves up before the T20 World Cup. Can't wait to get underway, right? Well, so can't we. Toss and teams up in a bit.
